chapters.title: Campus, data center and wireless architecture

topics.title: Three-tier campus design: access, distribution, core and collapsed core
paraphrases: The roles of the access, distribution and core layers, collapsing core and distribution, PoE at the access edge and uplink oversubscription.

topics.title: Spine-leaf data center topology
